summary: C6: chat response attribution line (model + tokens + cost)
description:
Per-response attribution line in the chat view (BRD §7.4). Sourced
from queries.model_used (resolved ID), queries.{input,output}_tokens,
queries.cost_usd — all already populated.

Format below each AI response:
    claude-sonnet-4.6 · 4.2k tokens · \$0.018

Files:
  - src/components/chat-view.tsx — append a small <div> after each
    AI message rendering the three values. ~15 lines.
    tokens.text.muted colour, smaller than body, no border.
  - src/lib/types.ts — extend message type if cost/tokens aren't
    already plumbed.
  - src/app/api/sessions/[id]/route.ts — verify GET response
    includes cost/tokens columns; extend SELECT if not.
  - src/__tests__/chat-view.test.ts (extend) — assert attribution
    line renders with resolved model id + formatted cost.

Done when:
  - Every AI response shows '<model_used> · <tokens> · \$<cost>'
    below body.
  - Model id matches queries.model_used for that query.
  - Streaming responses get the line populated after
    finalizeBudget writes the row (chat view re-fetch should
    surface this on first render after stream completes).
  - npm run lint clean.

Tests:
  - Component: render with fixture message, assert text content.
  - Smoke: query, verify line; switch picker, query, verify new
    responses show new id while old responses still show old id.

Operator action post-merge: none.

Depends on: C3 (queries.model_used populated from resolved ID).

resolution.note: Per-response attribution line in chat-view: '<model_used> · <Nk tokens> · $<cost>'. Sourced from queries columns surfaced through /api/sessions/[id]. Conditional field spread in recordsToMessages keeps legacy-row tests structurally identical. 3 new tests cover populated/legacy/truncated cases.
